description: The package draws `title="Expand"` on an SVG `<use>` after its `xlink:href`, and no source writes it — a `dist` built before the template lost it. The package's `PctWidget` is the declaration ngc wrote for that older template, whose `consts` hold `[0, 'xlink', 'href', '#pct-widget-icon', 'title', 'Expand']` (measured through ngc and the linker): `0` marks a namespaced attribute, which takes three slots, and ordinary pairs go on after it. A package read stopping at the first number lost the title. The older template put the marker on its icon, and a directive among the dependencies compiles the template to the full instructions (`ɵɵelement`, `ɵɵelementContainer`, `ɵɵtemplate`), where the reference's compile to the DOM-only ones: a read that does not know where one of them takes its attributes or its local references refuses this input at `unplaced-const` instead.
